stage_rows.source: So and Chan, Short-time frequency estimation of a real sinusoid (2005), IEICE Transactions on Fundamentals E88-A(9), 2455-2459, DOI 10.1093/ietfec/e88-a.9.2455.
exact_source_locators: CityUHK Scholars abstract and bibliographic record, https://scholars.cityu.edu.hk/en/publications/short-time-frequency-estimation-of-a-real-sinusoid/ (researcher OP05; verifier indexed record V1/V2)

Official IEICE author listing, 2005/09/01, E88-A No. 9, pp. 2455-2459, type LETTER, with Full Text: PDF, https://search.ieice.org/bin/author.php?a_name=Hing-Cheung+SO&abst=j&category=A&lang=E&year=2005 (researcher OP10; verifier indexed V1/V2)

CityUHK fingerprint entry classifies this publication under RGC 21, Publication in refereed journal / peer-review, https://scholars.cityu.edu.hk/en/publications/short-time-frequency-estimation-of-a-real-sinusoid/fingerprints/ (verifier V1/V2)
stage_rows.content_access: Abstract and metadata only; the listed full PDF was not accessed. Abstract directly states short-observation real-periodogram bias and proposes analytic-signal conversion or negative-spectral-line subtraction.
stage_rows.publication_status: Published journal letter verified by official IEICE listing.
stage_rows.peer_review_status: Yes, institutional CityUHK research record explicitly classifies it as peer-reviewed journal publication. This is institutional classification evidence, not a separately inspected editorial review record.
stage_rows.claim_support: Abstract-limited, supported for the stated short-record real-tone mechanism and two correction families. No quantitative performance claim is attributed to it.
stage_rows.task_applicability: Adequately mapped as a discriminator: H03 explicitly retains a real-capture conjugate-image/physical-sideband ambiguity. Stationary real sinusoid and short records are relevant model context; payload/helper envelope and front-end conditions remain unverified.
stage_rows.novelty_vs_seed: Qualified incremental finding. Seed F2/S2 compares Kay under a complex single-tone AWGN model; H03 flags image ambiguity but supplies no source-backed short-record negative-image bias or correction. The new source turns that caveat into a concrete check. Do not credit the verifier's retrieval as a researcher discovery.
stage_rows.practical_discriminator: On identical held-out real PCM, vary start phase and aperture length; compare incumbent and one implementable image correction. Record signed bias, absolute-error tails, branch/alias outcomes, and absent-tone admissions. Keep frequency-only authority separate.
unresolved_caveats: No equations, measured ranges, or comparative tables were retrieved for this 2005 abstract.
No support for the proposed 0.10-Hz/6-s/95% target or receiver performance.

Wiley abstract states complex sinusoid with independent zero-mean equal-variance normal real/imaginary additive noise, fixed-SNR inconsistency, and a restricted strongly consistent noise class with prior frequency-range knowledge.
stage_rows.content_access: Publisher-indexed abstract and metadata; full article not accessed. Publisher open failure at researcher OP04 remains accurate.
stage_rows.publication_status: Published journal article verified by Wiley citation and institutional record.
stage_rows.peer_review_status: Yes, Macquarie University publication record labels it a peer-reviewed journal article. No separate review record inspected.
stage_rows.claim_support: Abstract-limited, directly supports the specific estimator inconsistency claim and stated model. It does not support a conclusion about all Kay-family estimators.
stage_rows.task_applicability: Adequately mapped as a qualification of a proposed Kay comparator; not a prediction for the receiver. The exact estimator-variant correspondence to a future implementation is unresolved and must be checked before making implementation-specific claims.
stage_rows.novelty_vs_seed: Qualified incremental finding. Seed F2 supports considering a Kay-style comparator under its model and does not mention Quinn's consistency caveat. This changes how that comparator should be interpreted and what finite-record signed-bias checks to run.
stage_rows.practical_discriminator: Compare the selected Kay implementation over known generated offsets and actual finite apertures against an independent bounded profile fit/reference; retain signed bias, tail error, and no-publication outcomes.
unresolved_caveats: Kay estimator variant identity needs confirmation before implementation-specific transfer.
Abstract does not establish behavior on real-valued shaped captures, payload activity, or the proposed target.

stage_rows.source: So and Chan, Two Algorithms for Frequency Estimation of a Real Sinusoid from Short Data Records (2000), Proceedings of IEEE ISCAS 2000, vol. 3, pp. III-391–III-394, DOI 10.1109/ISCAS.2000.856079.
exact_source_locators: Author-hosted primary PDF, https://www.ee.cityu.edu.hk/~hcso/iscas00_2.pdf, pp. III-391–III-394; abstract and Sections I-III; researcher op3 opened PDF and op6 retrieved extracted text, verifier V1/V2 indexed full paper text and V5 opened the PDF (extractor returned no lines)
Author publication list, https://www.ee.cityu.edu.hk/~hcso/publication.html, entry for H.C. So and Y.T. Chan, ISCAS 2000, vol. 3, pp. 391-394 (researcher op10; verifier V1/V2/V8 surfaced record)
stage_rows.content_access: Primary paper full text accessed via search extraction; PDF independently opened but text extraction returned no lines. Paper gives x(n)=alpha cos(omega0 n+phi)+white Gaussian noise, unknown amplitude/frequency/phase, and targets short N (order 100 or less); Sections II-III attribute phase-, record-length-, and frequency-dependent periodogram bias to negative spectral-line interference and propose analytic-signal construction and negative-line subtraction.
stage_rows.publication_status: Proceedings publication verified by author publication list and paper's IEEE proceedings identity/copyright. Publisher DOI page was inaccessible to the researcher; no independent publisher landing-page record was retrieved.
stage_rows.peer_review_status: Unknown. Conference proceedings provenance is verified; available sources do not establish the review process. Not counted as a verified peer-reviewed primary source.
stage_rows.claim_support: Direct primary-text support for the mechanism and two proposed correction families. The paper's comparative experiments do not transfer as receiver performance evidence.
stage_rows.task_applicability: Adequately mapped as a real-sinusoid finite-record discriminator because H03 identifies real capture and image/sideband ambiguity. Applicability is limited by the paper's stationary one-tone AWGN model and short records; actual helper envelope, payload/auxiliary activity, offsets and levels remain unmatched.
stage_rows.novelty_vs_seed: Qualified incremental finding. Seed offers complex-sinusoid estimator comparisons and a generic coarse-search/outlier discussion; H03 records an unresolved image/sideband ambiguity but not this source-backed negative-image interference mechanism and remedy. It narrows the seed caveat into a falsifiable test.
stage_rows.practical_discriminator: On identical real PCM/noise controls, vary initial phase and observation length including windows that cross the 137-sample chunk boundaries; compare incumbent with one feasible image correction and a bounded local fit. Measure signed bias, deadline tail error, uncertainty coverage, false admissions, and chunk invariance separately.
